ask: Ask our Threads and X followers which flavour we should bring back: lavender, pistachio or black sesame.

arguments.content: We're bringing one flavour back. You choose:

steps.why: The decision: a Threads poll is the poll field on create-post, on a text post with no media (with media the poll isn't sent). X can't share this post: X ignores the poll field and needs its poll as an X setting, so X gets its own post. 3 options, short enough for both networks.

arguments.content: We're bringing one flavour back. You choose:

steps.why: X's own post: the question is the text.
X's poll is a setting; this call refuses an option over 25 characters or a bad duration instead of dropping it. One day: a quick choice.

say: Saved to Acme as 2 drafts. 1. Threads: "We're bringing one flavour back. You choose:" with a poll (Lavender, Pistachio, Black sesame), topic Ice Cream. 2. X: the same question as a one-day poll. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule both for the same time?
never: One post for Threads and X with the poll field: X would go out with no poll.
An image on the Threads poll post: the poll would be dropped.
A poll in a batch item: batch items carry no poll.
